# Chipmunk2D

Unmodified C sources and headers from Chipmunk-7.0.3.

- Repository: https://github.com/slembcke/Chipmunk2D
- Commit: 87340c216bf97554dc552371bbdecf283f7c540e
- License: MIT, retained in LICENSE.txt and the installed app resources.
- Only the ordinary single-threaded cpSpace is built; cpHastySpace is not linked.
- Singularity's force model and rendering are separate from the engine.
